article.title: Sunny Diamonds以女性成就為主題推廣金奈首店
article.summary: Madarth為Sunny Diamonds的金奈首店推出Find Your Shine，將女性的個人成就轉化為珠寶廣告主題。
highlights: 拍攝取材自紅毯和媒體迎拍場景，延伸至戶外、平面和數位媒體。
品牌安排Women Achievers內容系列，並為社群平台剪輯短版。
article.why: 新店行銷可由單一購買情境出發，規劃戶外廣告、店內展示及可持續更新的社群內容。
article.next_step: 以一類顧客的自購情境設計一組開店素材，分別檢查觸及、到店意向和到店紀錄。
article.detail: 據MediaNews4U報道，Sunny Diamonds首間金奈門市於10月31日開幕。Madarth把紅毯概念帶進廣告及開店邀請，並以女性如何看待自己取得的成就為訪談主題。首集Women Achievers已完成拍攝，其他集數及一批戶外版位仍屬計劃。品牌可分別衡量場地及內容的反應。
article.title_en: Sunny Diamonds makes women's achievements the focus of its Chennai launch campaign
article.summary_en: Madarth created Find Your Shine for Sunny Diamonds' first Chennai showroom, using women's personal milestones as the campaign theme.
highlights_en: The shoot borrows from red carpet and paparazzi imagery and runs across outdoor, print and digital.
The Women Achievers series pairs longer interviews with shorter edits for social channels.
article.why_en: Retail launch teams can build outdoor, store and ongoing social content around one specific reason to buy.
article.next_step_en: Design a launch asset set around one self-purchase occasion and track reach, intent to visit and recorded visits separately.
article.detail_en: MediaNews4U reports that the first Chennai showroom opened on October 31. Madarth used the red carpet concept for advertising and invitations and built the interview series around women's own milestones. The first Women Achievers episode has been filmed, with more episodes and outdoor placements planned. Retail teams can measure response to the venue and the content separately.
